state.not_connected: Card payments currently go to the platform's Stripe account. Connect your community's own Stripe account so donations are paid straight into your bank account.

disconnect_confirm.title: Disconnect this Stripe account?
disconnect_confirm.body: New card payments will go to the platform's Stripe account instead. Payments already taken stay in your Stripe account, and supporters with a recurring donation keep paying into it until they cancel.

how_it_works.title: What connecting changes
how_it_works.item_1: One-off donations are paid into your Stripe account.
how_it_works.item_2: Recurring support levels are billed from your Stripe account. They are set up there automatically the first time someone subscribes after you connect.
how_it_works.item_3: Refunds come from whichever account took the payment.
how_it_works.item_4: Until your account is ready, payments keep going to the platform's Stripe account and are recorded against your community.

before_you_start.title: Before you start
before_you_start.body: Stripe will ask for your organisation's details and the bank account to pay into. It usually takes about ten minutes, and you can come back and finish later.
before_you_start.fees: Stripe's own card-processing fees apply. The platform does not take a share of donations.
